info.title: Remote Connections Manager API
info.description: REST API of Remote Connections Manager. Authenticate with the browser session cookie (plus `X-CSRF-Token` header for unsafe methods) or with a personal API token (`Authorization: Bearer pat_…`). Errors use RFC 9457 problem details. POST endpoints that create resources honour the `Idempotency-Key` header.
